No defers.

findings.title: Git filter textarea clips last placeholder example
findings.problem: GIT_FILE_FILTER_PLACEHOLDER (src/constants/dataSources.ts) contains 10 lines (4 comment labels plus 6 pattern lines, with a trailing newline), but FilesFilterField is rendered with rows={9}. The 10th line, `/<folder_name>/**/*.cs`, falls outside the visible area, and textarea placeholders are not scrollable.
findings.impact: Users cannot see the any-depth `/<folder_name>/**/*.cs` example, which is the one that clarifies the one-level-only behavior of `/<folder_name>/*/*.cs`. This undercuts the ticket's purpose of accurate, readable examples. The path is live because every Git data source form renders this component.
findings.recommendation: Set rows={10} in IndexTypeGit.tsx and update any test that asserts rows=9. Check that the trailing newline in the placeholder does not need an 11th row.
